visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young man with black hair wearing a white t-shirt. He sits in a warm, dimly lit room at a glass desk, typing on a silver laptop. A small blue jar sits on the table beside him. (2) He is shown lying horizontally on the floor, seemingly asleep, using a grey pillow. (3) Back at the desk, he talks directly to the camera with a calm expression. The camera is eye-level. (4) He holds the blue jar up towards the lens, bringing it into focus while the background blurs. (5) In a brighter setting, he wears a white collared shirt. Close-up shots show him opening the blue jar and using a small spatula to scoop a white, gel-like substance onto the back of his hand. (6) He applies the cream to his cheeks while looking into a wooden-framed mirror. His skin appears hydrated. (7) He stands in front of a window with blinds, turning to look over his shoulder. (8) He sits on a stump in a studio with plants, looking at a large computer screen that displays a close-up of his face. Camera shutter sounds are visually represented by screen flashes. (9) Product shots of blue boxes and jars appear. He stands in a grey studio space, smiling confidently with his hands in his pockets.
